## FORM BLOCK: Form I-131

### form_identity

* Form I-131, Application for Travel Documents, Parole Documents, and Arrival/Departure Records.
* Revision 2026-10, jurisdiction US-TX.

### part_map

Interview order: Part 1 (Your travel document), Part 4 (A few checks before you travel), Part 2 (About you), Part 3 (What you look like), Part 7 (Your trip), Part 10 (How to reach you), Part 11 (Your interpreter).

#### Part 1: Your travel document
* q_p1_rtd_or_reentry (opens the part)
  * p1.screen_rtd_or_reentry: "A refugee travel document or a reentry permit", choice, required. Options: yes/no.
* q_p1_ap_pending_i485 (opens the part)
  * p1.ap_pending_i485: "Advance parole for a pending Form I-485 (Part 1, Item 5.A)" (Item 5A), choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p1_refugee_status
  * p1.refugee_status: "Refugee status, paroled as a refugee, or permanent resident as a refugee" (Item 13), choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p1_inside_us
  * p1.inside_us: "Inside the United States now" (Item 5), choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p1_filing_with_i485
  * p1.filing_with_i485: "How this I-131 is filed with the Form I-485" (Item 5A), choice, required. Options: same_package ("In the same package as my I-485"); sent_before ("I sent my I-485 before").
* q_p1_i485_receipt
  * p1.i485_receipt: "Form I-485 receipt number" (Item 5A), text, required if p1.filing_with_i485=="sent_before", max length 34.

#### Part 4: A few checks before you travel
* q_p4_proceedings_ever (opens the part)
  * p4.proceedings_ever: "Ever in exclusion, deportation, removal or rescission proceedings" (Item 1), choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p4_overstay
  * p4.screen_overstay: "Ever stayed past the I-94 date or after a status ended", choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p4_no_inspection
  * p4.screen_no_inspection: "Ever entered without inspection", choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p4_status_gap
  * p4.screen_status_gap: "Any time in the United States without lawful status", choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p4_prior_removal
  * p4.screen_prior_removal: "Ever denied entry, deported or removed, or left under voluntary departure", choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p4_false_identity
  * p4.screen_false_identity: "Ever gave a border officer a different name or date of birth", choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p4_criminal
  * p4.screen_criminal: "Ever arrested, cited, charged or convicted", choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p4_j_visa
  * p4.screen_j_visa: "Ever a J-1 exchange visitor or a J-2 dependent", choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p4_victim_based
  * p4.screen_victim_based: "Green card application based on VAWA, or on T or U status", choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p4_parole
  * p4.screen_parole: "On parole now, or last entered the United States on parole", choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p4_asylum
  * p4.screen_asylum: "Granted asylum, or an asylum application pending", choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p4_daca_tps
  * p4.screen_daca_tps: "DACA or TPS, or a TPS application pending", choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p4_pending_i539
  * p4.screen_pending_i539: "A Form I-539 to extend or change status is pending", choice, required. Options: yes; no; unsure ("I'm not sure").
* q_p4_had_reentry_or_rtd
  * p4.had_reentry_or_rtd: "Ever issued a reentry permit or refugee travel document" (Item 2a), choice, required. Options: yes/no.
* q_p4_reentry_or_rtd_issued
  * p4.reentry_or_rtd_issued: "Date that document was issued" (Item 2b), date, required if p4.had_reentry_or_rtd=="yes".
* q_p4_reentry_or_rtd_disposition
  * p4.reentry_or_rtd_disposition: "What happened to that document" (Item 2c), text, required if p4.had_reentry_or_rtd=="yes".
* q_p4_had_advance_parole
  * p4.had_advance_parole: "Ever issued an advance parole document" (Item 3a), choice, required. Options: yes/no.
* q_p4_advance_parole_issued
  * p4.advance_parole_issued: "Date that advance parole document was issued" (Item 3b), date, required if p4.had_advance_parole=="yes".
* q_p4_advance_parole_disposition
  * p4.advance_parole_disposition: "What happened to that advance parole document" (Item 3c), text, required if p4.had_advance_parole=="yes".
* q_p4_replacement
  * p4.replacement: "Requesting a replacement document" (Item 4), choice, required. Options: new_request ("A new request"); replacement ("A replacement for a document I already got").

#### Part 2: About you
* q_p2_full_name (opens the part)
  * p2.given_name: "Given name (first name)" (Item 1), text, required.
  * p2.middle_name: "Middle name" (Item 1), text, required if p2.has_middle_name=="yes".
  * p2.family_name: "Family name (last name)" (Item 1), text, required.
* q_p2_family_name
  * p2.family_name (described above).
* q_p2_middle_name_check
  * p2.has_middle_name: "Has a legal middle name" (Item 1), choice, required while p2.middle_name has no value. Options: yes/no.
* q_p2_middle_name
  * p2.middle_name (described above).
* q_p2_other_names_gate
  * p2.has_other_names: "Other names used" (Item 2), choice, required. Options: yes/no.
* q_p2_other_name1
  * p2.other_name1.given_name: "Other name 1: first name" (Item 2), text, required if p2.has_other_names=="yes".
  * p2.other_name1.middle_name: "Other name 1: middle name" (Item 2), text, optional.
  * p2.other_name1.family_name: "Other name 1: last name" (Item 2), text, required if p2.has_other_names=="yes".
* q_p2_other_name1_dob
  * p2.other_name1.date_of_birth: "Other name 1: date of birth used" (Item 2), date, required if p2.has_other_names=="yes".
* q_p2_other_names_more1
  * p2.has_other_name2: "Another other name" (Item 2), choice, required if p2.has_other_names=="yes". Options: yes/no.
* q_p2_other_name2
  * p2.other_name2.given_name: "Other name 2: first name" (Item 2), text, required if p2.has_other_name2=="yes".
  * p2.other_name2.middle_name: "Other name 2: middle name" (Item 2), text, optional.
  * p2.other_name2.family_name: "Other name 2: last name" (Item 2), text, required if p2.has_other_name2=="yes".
* q_p2_other_name2_dob
  * p2.other_name2.date_of_birth: "Other name 2: date of birth used" (Item 2), date, required if p2.has_other_name2=="yes".
* q_p2_other_names_more2
  * p2.has_other_name3: "Another other name" (Item 2), choice, required if p2.has_other_name2=="yes". Options: yes/no.
* q_p2_other_name3
  * p2.other_name3.given_name: "Other name 3: first name" (Item 2), text, required if p2.has_other_name3=="yes".
  * p2.other_name3.middle_name: "Other name 3: middle name" (Item 2), text, optional.
  * p2.other_name3.family_name: "Other name 3: last name" (Item 2), text, required if p2.has_other_name3=="yes".
* q_p2_other_name3_dob
  * p2.other_name3.date_of_birth: "Other name 3: date of birth used" (Item 2), date, required if p2.has_other_name3=="yes".
* q_p2_other_names_more3
  * p2.has_other_name4: "Another other name" (Item 2), choice, required if p2.has_other_name3=="yes". Options: yes/no.
* q_p2_other_name4
  * p2.other_name4.given_name: "Other name 4: first name" (Item 2), text, required if p2.has_other_name4=="yes".
  * p2.other_name4.middle_name: "Other name 4: middle name" (Item 2), text, optional.
  * p2.other_name4.family_name: "Other name 4: last name" (Item 2), text, required if p2.has_other_name4=="yes".
* q_p2_other_name4_dob
  * p2.other_name4.date_of_birth: "Other name 4: date of birth used" (Item 2), date, required if p2.has_other_name4=="yes".
* q_p2_mailing_address
  * p2.mailing_address.street: "Mailing address: Street address" (Item 3), text, required, max length 34.
  * p2.mailing_address.unit: "Mailing address: Apartment, suite, or floor" (Item 3), text, optional.
  * p2.mailing_address.city: "Mailing address: City" (Item 3), text, required, max length 20.
  * p2.mailing_address.state: "Mailing address: State" (Item 3), text, required.
  * p2.mailing_address.postal_code: "Mailing address: ZIP code" (Item 3), text, required, digits only, max length 5.
  * p2.mailing_address.in_care_of: "Mailing address: In care of name" (Item 3), text, optional, max length 34.
  * p2.mailing_address.country: "Mailing address: Country" (Item 3), text, optional.
* q_p2_mailing_address_street
  * p2.mailing_address.street (described above).
* q_p2_mailing_address_city
  * p2.mailing_address.city (described above).
* q_p2_mailing_address_state
  * p2.mailing_address.state (described above).
* q_p2_mailing_address_postal_code
  * p2.mailing_address.postal_code (described above).
* q_p2_mailing_is_physical
  * p2.mailing_is_physical: "Mailing address is the physical address" (Item 4), choice, required. Options: yes/no.
* q_p2_physical_address
  * p2.physical_address.street: "Physical address: Street address" (Item 4), text, required if p2.mailing_is_physical=="no", max length 34.
  * p2.physical_address.unit: "Physical address: Apartment, suite, or floor" (Item 4), text, optional.
  * p2.physical_address.city: "Physical address: City" (Item 4), text, required if p2.mailing_is_physical=="no", max length 20.
  * p2.physical_address.state: "Physical address: State" (Item 4), text, required if p2.mailing_is_physical=="no".
  * p2.physical_address.postal_code: "Physical address: ZIP code" (Item 4), text, required if p2.mailing_is_physical=="no", digits only, max length 5.
  * p2.physical_address.country: "Physical address: Country" (Item 4), text, optional.
* q_p2_physical_address_street
  * p2.physical_address.street (described above).
* q_p2_physical_address_city
  * p2.physical_address.city (described above).
* q_p2_physical_address_state
  * p2.physical_address.state (described above).
* q_p2_physical_address_postal_code
  * p2.physical_address.postal_code (described above).
* q_p2_a_number_gate
  * p2.has_a_number: "Has an A-Number" (Item 5), choice, required. Options: yes/no.
* q_p2_a_number
  * p2.a_number: "A-Number" (Item 5), text, required if p2.has_a_number=="yes", digits only, accepted digit counts 8 or 9, max length 9.
* q_p2_birth_country
  * p2.birth_country: "Country of birth" (Item 6), text, required.
* q_p2_citizenship1
  * p2.citizenship1: "Country of citizenship or nationality" (Item 7), text, required.
* q_p2_sex
  * p2.sex: "Sex" (Item 8), choice, required. Options: male; female.
* q_p2_date_of_birth
  * p2.date_of_birth: "Date of birth" (Item 9), date, required.
* q_p2_ssn_gate
  * p2.has_ssn: "Has a Social Security number" (Item 10), choice, required. Options: yes/no.
* q_p2_ssn
  * p2.ssn: "Social Security number" (Item 10), text, required if p2.has_ssn=="yes", digits only, max length 9.
* q_p2_uscis_account_gate
  * p2.has_uscis_account: "Has a USCIS online account number" (Item 11), choice, required. Options: yes/no.
* q_p2_uscis_account
  * p2.uscis_account_number: "USCIS online account number" (Item 11), text, required if p2.has_uscis_account=="yes", digits only, max length 12.
* q_p2_class_of_admission
  * p2.class_of_admission: "Class of admission" (Item 12), text, required.
* q_p2_i94_gate
  * p2.has_i94: "Has a Form I-94 number" (Item 13), choice, required. Options: yes/no.
* q_p2_i94_number
  * p2.i94_number: "Form I-94 number" (Item 13), text, required if p2.has_i94=="yes".
* q_p2_i94_expiry
  * p2.i94_expiry: "Date your authorized stay on the I-94 expires or expired" (Item 14), text, required if p2.has_i94=="yes".

#### Part 3: What you look like
* q_p3_ethnicity (opens the part)
  * p3.ethnicity: "Ethnicity" (Item 1), choice, required. Options: hispanic ("Hispanic or Latino"); not_hispanic ("Not Hispanic or Latino").
* q_p3_race
  * p3.race_american_indian: "Race: American Indian or Alaska Native" (Item 2), yes or no box, optional, check field, a checked box files "yes".
  * p3.race_asian: "Race: Asian" (Item 2), yes or no box, optional, check field, a checked box files "yes".
  * p3.race_black: "Race: Black or African American" (Item 2), yes or no box, optional, check field, a checked box files "yes".
  * p3.race_pacific_islander: "Race: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander" (Item 2), yes or no box, optional, check field, a checked box files "yes".
  * p3.race_white: "Race: White" (Item 2), yes or no box, optional, check field, a checked box files "yes".
* q_p3_height_weight
  * p3.height_feet: "Height: feet" (Item 3), number, required.
  * p3.height_inches: "Height: inches" (Item 3), number, required.
  * p3.weight_pounds: "Weight in pounds" (Item 4), number, required.
* q_p3_height_weight_height_feet
  * p3.height_feet (described above).
* q_p3_height_weight_height_inches
  * p3.height_inches (described above).
* q_p3_height_weight_weight_pounds
  * p3.weight_pounds (described above).
* q_p3_eye_hair
  * p3.eye_color: "Eye color" (Item 5), choice, required. Options: brown; blue; green; hazel; gray; black; pink; maroon; other ("Unknown or other").
  * p3.hair_color: "Hair color" (Item 6), choice, required. Options: bald ("Bald (no hair)"); sandy; red; white; gray; blond; brown; black; other ("Unknown or other").
* q_p3_eye_hair_eye_color
  * p3.eye_color (described above).
* q_p3_eye_hair_hair_color
  * p3.hair_color (described above).

#### Part 7: Your trip
* q_p7_trip_planned (opens the part)
  * p7.trip_planned: "A trip is planned" (Item 1), choice, required. Options: yes/no.
* q_p7_departure_date
  * p7.departure_date: "Date of intended departure" (Item 1), date, required if p7.trip_planned=="yes".
* q_p7_departure_note
  * p7.departure_note: "When you plan to leave, in your words" (Item 1), text, required if p7.trip_planned=="no".
* q_p7_purpose
  * p7.purpose: "Purpose of the trip" (Item 2), text, required.
* q_p7_countries
  * p7.countries: "Countries you intend to visit" (Item 3), text, required.
* q_p7_trips
  * p7.trips: "How many trips you intend to use this document for" (Item 4), choice, required. Options: one_trip; more_trips ("More than one trip").
* q_p7_length
  * p7.length_days: "Expected length of the trip in days" (Item 5), text, required.

#### Part 10: How to reach you
* q_p10_reads_english (opens the part)
  * p10.reads_english: "Can read and understand English" (Item 1), choice, required. Options: yes/no.
* q_p10_contact
  * p10.daytime_phone: "Your contact: daytime phone" (Item 1), text, required, digits only, max length 10.
  * p10.mobile_phone: "Your contact: mobile phone" (Item 2), text, optional, digits only, max length 10.
  * p10.email: "Your contact: email" (Item 3), text, optional.
* q_p10_contact_daytime_phone
  * p10.daytime_phone (described above).

#### Part 11: Your interpreter
* q_p11_interpreter_language (opens the part)
  * p11.interpreter_language: "Language the interpreter used" (Item 6), text, required if p10.reads_english=="no", max length 18.
* q_p11_interpreter_name
  * p11.interpreter.given_name: "Interpreter: first name" (Item 1), text, required if p10.reads_english=="no".
  * p11.interpreter.family_name: "Interpreter: last name" (Item 1), text, required if p10.reads_english=="no".
* q_p11_interpreter_business_gate
  * p11.interpreter_has_business: "The interpreter works for a business or organization" (Item 2), choice, required if p10.reads_english=="no". Options: yes/no.
* q_p11_interpreter_business
  * p11.interpreter_business: "Interpreter's business or organization name" (Item 2), text, required if p11.interpreter_has_business=="yes", max length 34.
* q_p11_interpreter_contact
  * p11.interpreter.daytime_phone: "Interpreter: daytime phone" (Item 3), text, required if p10.reads_english=="no", digits only, max length 10.
  * p11.interpreter.mobile_phone: "Interpreter: mobile phone" (Item 4), text, optional, digits only, max length 10.
  * p11.interpreter.email: "Interpreter: email" (Item 5), text, optional.
* q_p11_interpreter_contact_daytime_phone
  * p11.interpreter.daytime_phone (described above).

No node asks these fields: p10.signature_date, p11.interpreter_signature_date.

* [parts_never_discussed] Never discussed: the header's Form G-28 box; Part 2 Items 16 to 27 (someone filing for another person); Part 4 Items 5 to 9 (replacements and pickup abroad); Part 5 (reentry permit only); Part 6 (refugee travel document only); Parts 8 and 9 (parole paths, which stop the case); and Part 12, the preparer, which stays blank. Part 2 Item 15 prints the same for everyone this form serves, and the client fills Part 13 itself with any answer too long for its box. The signatures and their dates in Parts 10 and 11 are never asked.

### never_asks

* [never_asks_list] Nothing on this form asks for a job, an employment history, an address history, a spouse, a child or a school, so no such question is ever asked.

### stop_answers

* q_p1_rtd_or_reentry (p1.screen_rtd_or_reentry): when answer == "yes", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_not_built_yet.
* q_p1_ap_pending_i485 (p1.ap_pending_i485): when answer != "yes", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_application_type.
* q_p1_refugee_status (p1.refugee_status): when answer != "no", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_refugee_question_yes.
* q_p1_inside_us (p1.inside_us): when answer != "yes", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_already_outside.
* q_p4_proceedings_ever (p4.proceedings_ever): when answer != "no", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_proceedings_ever.
* q_p4_overstay (p4.screen_overstay): when answer != "no", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_unlawful_presence_overstay.
* q_p4_no_inspection (p4.screen_no_inspection): when answer != "no", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_unlawful_presence_no_inspection.
* q_p4_status_gap (p4.screen_status_gap): when answer != "no", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_unlawful_presence_status_gap.
* q_p4_prior_removal (p4.screen_prior_removal): when answer != "no", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_prior_entry_or_reentry_issue.
* q_p4_false_identity (p4.screen_false_identity): when answer != "no", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_prior_entry_or_reentry_issue.
* q_p4_criminal (p4.screen_criminal): when answer != "no", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_criminal_history.
* q_p4_j_visa (p4.screen_j_visa): when answer != "no", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_j1_212e.
* q_p4_victim_based (p4.screen_victim_based): when answer != "no", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_victim_based.
* q_p4_parole (p4.screen_parole): when answer != "no", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_parole_paths.
* q_p4_asylum (p4.screen_asylum): when answer != "no", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_asylum.
* q_p4_daca_tps (p4.screen_daca_tps): when answer != "no", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_daca_or_tps.
* q_p4_replacement (p4.replacement): when answer == "replacement", ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_replacement.
* q_p2_class_of_admission (p2.class_of_admission): when answer in ["PAR", "DT", "UHP", "OAR", "CHP", "HHP", "NHP", "VHP", "WHP", "CC", "CH", "CM", "CP", "DA", "OP", "PR", "HF", "MIL", "RCU", "HFRP"], ESCALATE determine_eligibility, reason i131_parole_class_of_admission.
* These fields offer unsure: p1.ap_pending_i485, p1.refugee_status, p1.inside_us, p4.proceedings_ever, p4.screen_overstay, p4.screen_no_inspection, p4.screen_status_gap, p4.screen_prior_removal, p4.screen_false_identity, p4.screen_criminal, p4.screen_j_visa, p4.screen_victim_based, p4.screen_parole, p4.screen_asylum, p4.screen_daca_tps, p4.screen_pending_i539.

* [stop_reply_ends] This form has no note lines. After a stop answer the phone shows the attorney screen and the lane asks nothing more: the reply says once, in one plain sentence and without consequences, that her answers mean an immigration attorney should look at her case before she travels, and it ends there, with no question. Two stops are not an attorney matter and name no attorney: on i131_replacement the reply says once that the app doesn't prepare a replacement travel document yet, and on i131_not_built_yet that the app doesn't prepare a refugee travel document or a reentry permit yet. No reply ever says or implies that travel is safe.

### value_specifics

* Check field p3.race_american_indian (q_p3_race): a checked box files "yes"; a box she does not name is never filed.
* Check field p3.race_asian (q_p3_race): a checked box files "yes"; a box she does not name is never filed.
* Check field p3.race_black (q_p3_race): a checked box files "yes"; a box she does not name is never filed.
* Check field p3.race_pacific_islander (q_p3_race): a checked box files "yes"; a box she does not name is never filed.
* Check field p3.race_white (q_p3_race): a checked box files "yes"; a box she does not name is never filed.

* [i94_expiry_ds] (applies to q_p2_i94_expiry) p2.i94_expiry is a text field, not a date field: file the Admit Until date as MM/DD/YYYY, or the letters D/S exactly as written when that is what her I-94 says. D/S is never turned into a date, and no date is asked for after it.
* [class_of_admission_code] (applies to q_p2_class_of_admission) p2.class_of_admission is filed as the code printed after COA on her I-94, as printed (B2, F1, PAR, DT), never as her own words for it. When her words name parole but give no code ("I came in on parole"), the reply asks once for the code after COA on her I-94.
* [height_weight_metric] (applies to q_p3_height_weight, q_p3_height_weight_height_feet, q_p3_height_weight_height_inches, q_p3_height_weight_weight_pounds) Height is filed as feet and inches and weight as pounds, whole numbers. When she gives meters, centimeters or kilos, convert the way the client does: total inches are centimeters divided by 2.54 (or meters times 39.3701), rounded to the nearest inch, then filed as feet and the inches left over; pounds are kilos times 2.20462, rounded to the nearest pound. Read the converted values back with what she said.

### identifiers

* p1.i485_receipt: "Form I-485 receipt number" (Item 5A), text, required if p1.filing_with_i485=="sent_before", max length 34.
* p2.a_number: "A-Number" (Item 5), text, required if p2.has_a_number=="yes", digits only, accepted digit counts 8 or 9, max length 9.
* p2.ssn: "Social Security number" (Item 10), text, required if p2.has_ssn=="yes", digits only, max length 9.
* p2.uscis_account_number: "USCIS online account number" (Item 11), text, required if p2.has_uscis_account=="yes", digits only, max length 12.
* p2.i94_number: "Form I-94 number" (Item 13), text, required if p2.has_i94=="yes".

### risk_triggers

* Warning i131_pending_i539: when p4.screen_pending_i539 any_of ["yes", "unsure"].
* Warning i131_urgent_travel: when p7.departure_date within_days 45.
* Warning i131_minor_under_14: when p2.date_of_birth age_under_years 14.
* Warning i131_long_absence: when p7.length_days number_at_least 365.

* [warnings_card_speaks] The warnings listed here are cards the client shows when her answer meets their condition. Say nothing about them: the card speaks, and the interview carries on.

### opening_documents

* [opening_documents] The documents that hold her answers: an official photo ID such as her work permit (EAD), driver's license, passport ID page or green card; any USCIS document that shows her current status, such as a Form I-797; her most recent I-94; and her Form I-485 receipt notice (Form I-797C) when the I-485 was sent before this form.
